lines.en: label rindorm10:
I knock on the door and don't have time to narrate anything else as Rin answers right away.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲门，还没来得及再旁白点什么，Rin 就立刻应声了。

lines.en: : It’s open!
lines.zh: : 门开着！

lines.en: scene black
scene rindten1
: Yo! What’s crackin', homeslice?
lines.zh: : 哟！怎么样啊，老铁？

lines.en: : Greet me like a normal human being please.
lines.zh: : 请用正常人类的打招呼方式，谢谢。

lines.en: : Good afternoon, Sir. Thank you for deciding to accompany me on this lovely summer night.
lines.zh: : 下午好，先生。感谢您决定在这个美好的夏夜陪在我身边。

lines.en: : Closer, but still a little off.
lines.zh: : 接近了，但还是有点怪。

lines.en: : Sup bitch?
lines.zh: : 咋样啊，碧池？

lines.en: : Okay, let's just skip the greetings and get right to talking. What are you up to?
lines.zh: : 好吧，那就跳过寒暄，直接聊正事。你在忙什么？

lines.en: : Oh, you know. A little of this, a little of that.
lines.zh: : 哦，你知道的。做点这个，搞点那个。

lines.en: : Was about to play a game or something but {i}I guess{/i} I can hang out with you instead.
lines.zh: : 本来打算打个游戏什么的，不过{i}我想{/i}跟你待着也行。

lines.en: : How generous of you.
lines.zh: : 你真是慷慨。

lines.en: : Generous would be my middle name if I was born in America and actually got to have one.
lines.zh: : 我要是生在美国、还真有中间名的话，我的中间名大概就是「慷慨」。

lines.en: scene rindten2
: Futaba will be out for a while anyway, so we're free to chill without worrying about her walking in on us.
lines.zh: : 反正 Futaba 还要在外面待一阵子，所以我们想怎么放松都行，不用担心她撞进来。

lines.en: : Wording it that way makes it sound like you're planning on taking advantage of me.
lines.zh: : 你这措辞听起来像是在打算占我便宜。

lines.en: : Do you {i}want{/i} me to take advantage of you?
lines.zh: : 你{i}想{/i}让我占你便宜吗？

lines.en: : I wouldn't mind.
lines.zh: : 我不介意啊。

lines.en: : Not even with all of my skulls watching?
lines.zh: : 就算我身上这些骷髅都在看着？

lines.en: : Okay, I might mind a little.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我可能有一点点介意。

lines.en: : That's what I thought. Can't imagine I'm very attractive in this get-up anyway.
lines.zh: : 我就知道。反正穿着这身，我大概也没什么吸引力可言。

lines.en: : It is certainly an interesting choice for pajamas.
lines.zh: : 作为睡衣来说，这确实是个很有意思的选择。

lines.en: scene rindten3
: You know, I hear the same thing every time I sleep over in someone else's room.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，每次我在别人房间过夜，都会听到同样的话。

lines.en: : What happened to the good old days where girls were free to wear t-shirts and basketball shorts whenever they wanted? It’s not like I’m going to sleep in a three-piece suit.
lines.zh: : 从前那种女孩想穿 T 恤和篮球短裤就穿的日子都去哪儿了？我又不会穿着三件套西装睡觉。

lines.en: : You know, in a weird way, I think you actually pull off this...extremely traditional look?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，从某种奇怪的角度说，我觉得你其实把这种……极其传统的打扮驾驭得还挺好的？

lines.en: scene rindten4
: Thanks, Sensei. And, for what it's worth, I think you can rock the black blazer and white shirt combo better than I ever could.
lines.zh: : 谢啦，Sensei。话说回来，我觉得你穿黑西装外套配白衬衫的组合，绝对比我穿要好看。

lines.en: : If you're ever looking to test that theory out, I'd be more than happy to lend you the outfit. I have several pairs, so nothing will be missed.
lines.zh: : 你要是想验证一下这个说法，我非常乐意把那套衣服借你。我有好几套，少一套也没人会发现。

lines.en: : I'm glad to have finally confirmed that you're not just wearing the exact same pair of clothes all the time.
lines.zh: : 总算确认了你不是一直穿着完全同一套衣服，我很欣慰。

lines.en: scene rindten5
: So, are you ready to talk business or what?
lines.zh: : 那么，你准备好谈正事了吗？

lines.en: : Business? What kind of business exactly? Because not only did I forget my wallet at home, but I can't imagine ever wanting to buy something without caffeine from you.
lines.zh: : 正事？什么正事？我不仅把钱包忘在家里了，而且我实在想不出有什么不带咖啡因的东西是我想从你这儿买的。

lines.en: : Not even if it had giant boobs?
lines.zh: : 就算它有巨大的胸部也不行？

lines.en: : Are you...selling something with giant boobs?
lines.zh: : 你是……在卖什么有大胸部的东西？

lines.en: scene rindten6
: No, dude. I just want to know if you've talked to Futaba yet.
lines.zh: : 不是啦，老兄。我只是想知道你跟 Futaba 谈过了没有。

lines.en: : Talked to her about what?
lines.zh: : 跟她谈什么？

lines.en: : How you know she likes you and stuff!
lines.zh: : 就是你怎么知道她喜欢你之类的事啊！

lines.en: : Didn't you specifically tell me to {i}not{/i} mention that to her?
lines.zh: : 你不是专门叫过我{i}别{/i}跟她提这个吗？

lines.en: : I told you to not reveal that {i}I{/i} told you. I didn't think you'd just treat the information like it's not valid or whatever.
lines.zh: : 我叫你别透露是{i}我{/i}告诉你的。我可没想过你会干脆把这信息当成不存在什么的。

lines.en: if futabadorm15 == False:
: So...what do you want me to do? Walk up to her and tell her I know she likes me?
lines.zh: : 那……你想让我怎么做？走到她面前跟她说我知道她喜欢我？

lines.en: : For most other people, I wouldn't recommend that at all. But for Futaba, I actually think that sort of method might work.
lines.zh: : 换作别人，我根本不会这么建议。但对 Futaba，我还真觉得这种法子可能管用。

lines.en: : At the very least, you should at least make a move. I think you guys would be super cute together.
lines.zh: : 至少，你总该主动一点吧。我觉得你们两个在一起会超级可爱。

lines.en: else:
I'm not treating the information as if it's not valid. I'm just already {i}very{/i} aware of Futaba's feelings for me as {i}my{/i} feelings for {i}her{/i} wound up all over her face recently.
lines.zh: 我并没有把这信息当成不存在。我只是早就{i}很{/i}清楚 Futaba 对我的感情了——毕竟最近{i}我的{/i}感情全都糊在{i}她{/i}脸上了。

lines.en: It's nice knowing that even though she's extremely close to Rin, Futaba hasn't come out and told her that yet.
lines.zh: 不过知道这件事也不坏：哪怕 Futaba 跟 Rin 亲近到那种地步，她到现在也还没跟她说出口。

lines.en: Granted, I can't imagine bringing up the fact that you gave a teacher a handjob is an easy thing to discuss with a friend...
lines.zh: 当然，我也能想象，「你给一个老师打了个手枪」这种事，要跟朋友开口确实不容易……

lines.en: But honestly, based on how Rin's acted about the two of us so far, I wouldn't be surprised to hear if she was super into the thought of that.
lines.zh: 但老实说，看 Rin 到目前为止对我们两个的态度，就算听说她对那种念头超级来劲，我也不会惊讶。

lines.en: : You know, you've been really trying to push this Futaba thing on me lately and I'm not really sure if I get it.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，你最近一直拼命想把 Futaba 这件事往我身上推，我不太确定自己理不理解。

lines.en: scene rindten7
: What do you mean? What don't you get?
lines.zh: : 什么意思？哪点不理解？

lines.en: : Like, it's one thing to think that the two of us would make a cute couple. But it's another thing if you're going to try and push me in her direction every time we talk.
lines.zh: : 就是，觉得我们两个能凑成一对可爱情侣是一回事；可你每次跟我说话都要把我往她那边推，那就是另一回事了。

lines.en: : Not {i}every{/i} time. Just a lot of the time until you two hook up. I promise I'll shut up after that.
lines.zh: : 也不是{i}每{/i}次啦。只是在你们搞在一起之前会经常推。我保证之后就闭嘴。

lines.en: : I just don't understand what you're getting out of this is all.
lines.zh: : 我只是不明白你能从中得到什么。

lines.en: scene rindten7r
: Sensei...Futaba is my best friend. I just want her to be happy.
lines.zh: : Sensei……Futaba 是我最好的朋友。我只是想让她幸福。

lines.en: : And I also can't imagine a future where you don't want to motorboat her enormous tits.
lines.zh: : 而且我也无法想象，会有一个你不想把脸埋进她那对巨乳里的未来。

lines.en: : You have a really odd way with words sometimes, Rin.
lines.zh: : 你有时候用词真的好奇怪，Rin。

lines.en: scene rindten8
: Oh, right! That reminds me!
lines.zh: : 哦，对了！我想起来了！

lines.en: : I think Haruka wants a piece of you too since she's brought you up not once, not twice, but {i}three{/i} times now!
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Haruka 也想分你一杯羹，因为她提到你不是一次、不是两次，而是整整{i}三{/i}次了！

lines.en: : How do you keep attracting all of these extremely voluptuous women?
lines.zh: : 你是怎么总能吸引到这些丰乳肥臀的女人的？

lines.en: : I suppose I'm just extremely lucky. Isn't Haruka married, though?
lines.zh: : 我想我只是运气极好吧。不过 Haruka 不是已婚吗？

lines.en: : Yeah! That's why this whole thing was a huge surprise for me. Like, I thought she was super devoted to her husband, but apparently not.
lines.zh: : 对啊！所以整件事对我来说才是个巨大的惊喜。就像，我本来以为她对她丈夫特别专一，但显然不是。

lines.en: : Like, I get that all women have needs and stuff, but I wasn't expecting her to start fantasizing about the first decently attractive guy to come into the store since the space war started.
lines.zh: : 就是说，我明白所有女人都有需求什么的，但我没想到她会开始幻想——幻想太空战争开始之后第一个走进店里的、还算帅的男人。

lines.en: : Thank you for the accidental compliment, Rin.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你这无心的一句夸奖，Rin。

lines.en: scene rindten7
: Accidental? No, that wasn't accidental.
lines.zh: : 无心？不，那才不是无心。

lines.en: : You're pretty hot, Sensei. I just don't know if I'm allowed to say that until my boobs grow like, eight more sizes.
lines.zh: : 你挺帅的，Sensei。我只是不确定在我的胸部再大八个号之前，能不能这么说。

lines.en: : On the real, though, if you {i}actually{/i} want to go after Haruka...I don't think it's impossible anymore.
lines.zh: : 不过说真的，如果你{i}真{/i}想追 Haruka……我觉得现在已经不是不可能了。

lines.en: Huh...
It's not like I'm entirely opposed to that. Haruka's extremely attractive.
lines.zh: 我也不是完全反对。Haruka 确实极有魅力。

lines.en: It's just a matter of whether or not I want to lead someone like her down that sort of path or just...let her find her way on her own.
lines.zh: 问题只在于，我是想亲自把像她这样的人引上那条路，还是……让她自己找过去。

lines.en: : Well, thank you for once again telling me about a girl who wants to fuck me.
lines.zh: : 好吧，又一次谢谢你告诉我有个女孩想跟我上床。

lines.en: scene rindten8r
: Well...Haruka, yeah. But I don't know if Futaba wants to do {i}that{/i} just yet. She's a bit of a...late bloomer, if you know what I mean.
lines.zh: : 嗯……Haruka 算是吧。但我不知道 Futaba 现在想不想做{i}那个{/i}。她有点……晚熟，你懂我意思吧。

lines.en: if futabadorm15 == True:
She is certainly in bloom now.
lines.zh: 她现在确实已经绽放了。

lines.en: : But, uhh...yeah. Don't worry about it. That's what friends are for, right?
lines.zh: : 不过，呃……是啊。别担心这个。朋友就是干这个的，对吧？

lines.en: : Like...if somebody ever liked me, I'd want you to tell me about it.
lines.zh: : 就是……要是有人喜欢过我，我也会希望你能告诉我。

lines.en: : In fact, please {i}do{/i} tell me about it. That's not something I want to be kept secret from me.
lines.zh: : 事实上，请{i}务必{/i}告诉我。这种事我不希望被瞒着。

lines.en: : I mean...sure. But literally everyone I know is a girl, so...
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……当然。可我认识的人基本上全是女生，所以……

lines.en: : Wait-
lines.zh: : 等等——

lines.en: scene rindten9
: I'll save you the awkwardness of actually asking and just say yes now.
lines.zh: : 我就替你省下开口问的尴尬，现在直接说「是」好了。

lines.en: : So...you're a lesbian, then?
lines.zh: : 所以……你是女同？

lines.en: : Yes.
: Kind of.
lines.zh: : 算是吧。

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不是。

lines.en: : I'm not sure if I follow.
lines.zh: : 我不确定我听懂了。

lines.en: : Like...I'm bi. I think. No. I don't think. I'm definitely bi. Probably.
lines.zh: : 就是……我是双性恋。我觉得。不，不是觉得。我肯定是双性恋。大概吧。

lines.en: : I've just always been, like...way more attracted to girls than I am to guys.
lines.zh: : 只是我从以前开始就……对女生的兴趣远大于对男生的兴趣。

lines.en: : Like, {i}way{/i} more. A scary amount more.
lines.zh: : {i}远{/i}大于。大到吓人的那种。

lines.en: scene rindten10
: Soooo...yeah. If you ever know about anyone who was interested in me, I'd definitely want to know, like...ASAP.
lines.zh: : 那——么……是啊。要是你什么时候知道有谁对我有意思，我绝对会想知道，就是……越快越好。

lines.en: : Especially if it was one person in particular who definitely {i}doesn't{/i} like me, but I like to pretend she does because it makes me feel warm inside.
lines.zh: : 尤其是如果那个人是某个明确{i}不{/i}喜欢我、而我却喜欢假装她喜欢我的人——因为那会让我心里暖暖的。

lines.en: It has to be Chika she's talking about, right?
lines.zh: 她说的肯定是 Chika 吧？

lines.en: I've seen the way Rin looks at her before. She can barely even focus when she's around.
lines.zh: 我见过 Rin 看她的眼神。只要她在旁边，Rin 几乎就没法集中注意力。

lines.en: I don't think now is the right time to ask, though- considering she's only been open about her sexuality with me for a good thirty seconds now.
lines.zh: 不过我觉得现在不是问的时机——毕竟她才刚对我公开自己的性取向，前后也就三十秒。

lines.en: : Wow. Is it getting hot in here or is it just me?
lines.zh: : 哇。是这里变热了，还是只有我这么觉得？

lines.en: : Why are you telling me this?
lines.zh: : 你为什么要告诉我这个？

lines.en: scene rindten11
: Should I...not have done that?
lines.zh: : 我……不该说吗？

lines.en: : I thought you'd understand. But if-
lines.zh: : 我以为你会懂的。但如果——

lines.en: : No, I understand completely. I guess I just didn't realize we were close enough to be learning secrets like that about each other.
lines.zh: : 不，我完全懂。我只是没想到我们已经亲密到可以知道彼此这种秘密了。

lines.en: : You...didn't realize...
lines.zh: : 你……没想到……

lines.en: scene rindten12
: Hah...
: So, like...yeah. I know we haven't known each other that long. And I'm not like, {i}totally{/i} out yet, so you're definitely one of the only people to know for sure...
lines.zh: : 就是……是啊。我知道我们认识的时间还不长。而且我还没有、{i}完全{/i}没有公开出柜，所以你绝对是少数确定知道的人之一……

lines.en: scene rindten13
: I just kind of feel...comfortable enough with you I guess. Which is probably weird since I'm a teenage girl and you're a middle-ish age guy who could probably be my dad-
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得……跟你在一起挺自在的，大概。这应该挺奇怪的，毕竟我是个十几岁的女孩，而你是那种可能当我爸都行的中年左右的男人——

lines.en: : You can leave that part out in the future. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 以后这部分就省了吧。谢了。

lines.en: : I just mean that even though we're totally different people living totally different lives...I kind of like the idea of you being a...bigger part of mine?
lines.zh: : 我的意思只是，哪怕我们完全是不同的人、过着完全不同的生活……我有点喜欢你成为我生命中……更大一部分的这个想法？

lines.en: : Is that weird to say? Am I being weird? Is {i}this{/i} weird? Are things going to be weird from now on?
lines.zh: : 这么说很怪吗？我是不是有点怪？{i}这{/i}很怪吗？从今往后事情会变怪吗？

lines.en: : Nah. Nothing is going to change at all.
lines.zh: : 不会。什么都不会变的。

lines.en: : In fact, the two of us can probably bond over our shared love for teenage girls from now on.
lines.zh: : 事实上，从今往后我们两个大概还能因为「都爱十几岁的女孩」这一点而更交心呢。

lines.en: scene rindten14
: Sensei! That's so sweet and only moderately creepy for you to say!
lines.zh: : Sensei！你说得太贴心了，而且对你来说只是中等程度的 creepy！

lines.en: : Hey, you're the one trying to hook me up with your roommate. But now, I'm wondering if that's just some sort of wish fulfillment thing for you.
lines.zh: : 嘿，明明是你一直在撮合我和你室友。不过现在我在想，那会不会只是你的某种愿望投射。

lines.en: scene rindten15
: What?! No no no no no no, it's not like that at all! I'd never even think about doing something like that with-
lines.zh: : 什么？！不不不不不不，绝对不是那样！我从来没想过要跟她做那种——

lines.en: scene rindten16

: Well, actually, that's not entirely true because I definitely {i}have{/i} thought about doing things like that with Futaba before...but purely in a fantasy world and never in real life since she's straight.
lines.zh: : 好吧，其实也不完全是这样，因为我{i}确实{/i}幻想过跟 Futaba 做那种事……但纯粹只存在于幻想世界里，现实中绝对不会，因为她是直的。

lines.en: scene rindten15
: But that's not what the hookup thing is about at all. I really {i}do{/i} want you two to get together. And not just so I can fantasize about it. I already do that anyway.
lines.zh: : 但撮合你们这件事根本不是那么回事。我{i}是{/i}真的希望你们两个能在一起。而且不只是为了让我能拿来幻想。反正我本来就在幻想了。

lines.en: : I mean what? I didn't just say that. That was the wind.
lines.zh: : 我说什么来着？我刚才没说那个。那是风说的。

lines.en: : Would it make you feel better if I openly admitted to fantasizing about you as well?
lines.zh: : 如果我坦白承认我也幻想过你，你会不会好受一点？

lines.en: scene rindten17
: You know, in a weird way, I really think it would.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，从某种奇怪的角度说，我真的会觉得好受。

lines.en: : Then, I formally admit to fantasizing about you at least several times per week.
lines.zh: : 那么，我正式承认，每周至少会幻想你几次。

lines.en: : And everyone else, for that matter.
lines.zh: : 顺便还有所有其他人。

lines.en: : Thank you, Sensei. I really appreciate that.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Sensei。我真的很感激。

lines.en: : No problem, Rin. That's what friends are for, isn't it?
lines.zh: : 不客气，Rin。朋友就是干这个的，不是吗？

lines.en: : You should probably go now.
lines.zh: : 你现在大概该走了。

lines.en: : Yeah, I think that's a good idea.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我觉得这是个好主意。

lines.en: scene black
I quietly leave Rin's dorm room, still confused about how things so quickly spiraled out of control tonight, but at least I'm leaving with something valuable.
lines.zh: 我悄无声息地离开了 Rin 的宿舍，对今晚的一切怎么会这么快就失控依旧摸不着头脑，但至少我带着某样有价值的东西走了。

lines.en: And no- I'm not talking about the various, guaranteed lesbian fantasies that will plague my mind every time I look at her from now on.
lines.zh: 而不——我说的不是那些从今往后每次看到她都会在我脑子里作祟的、必定是女同的幻想。

lines.en: I'm talking about the fact that, despite me being an outwardly horrible person who rarely does anything selfless or good for {i}anyone{/i} other than myself-
lines.zh: 我说的是：尽管我表面上是个糟糕的人，极少为除自己以外的{i}任何人{/i}做过什么无私或善良的事——

lines.en: Despite all that, I am trusted.
lines.zh: 尽管是这样，我依然被信任着。

lines.en: I am trusted and I am leaving the dorm with one of Rin's secrets.
lines.zh: 我被信任着，而我带着 Rin 的一个秘密离开了宿舍。

lines.en: And only time will tell if she'll regret handing it to me.
lines.zh: 至于她会不会后悔把它交给了我，只有时间能给出答案。

lines.en: $ rindorm10 = True
$ rin_love += 1
